source_text: Si lepra totum corpus operuerit et alba fuerit, mundus est. Totalis confessio candidum facit. Qui partem tegit, manet immundus.
pass_a_gloss: If leprosy whole body will-have-covered and white will-have-been, clean he-is. Total confession bright makes. Who part covers, remains unclean.
pass_b_english: If leprosy [[covers the whole body and turns white, he is clean >> Bible:Leviticus 13:12-13]]. Full confession makes bright. Who hides a part stays unclean.
